settings.heading: How Viha Began
settings.body:
Viha Online grew from Mrs Anitha Kuppusamy's love for Indian pooja traditions and Ayurvedic care. She grew up with the rituals, fragrances and crafts of Tamil Nadu, and wanted families everywhere to be able to buy them.

She personally selects every product we sell, from brass idols to handmade Ayurvedic soaps.

We are based in Chennai and ship pooja, wellness and festive essentials across India and abroad.
